headline.purpose: 桌面的页面标题（歌单、专辑、歌手、已下载、搜索结果）。每日推荐的日期大数字是图形，不算阶梯里的一档。

headline-sm.purpose: 手机的页面标题、桌面播放页的歌名（24px）。

title.purpose: 首页区块标题、手机播放页的歌名。

title-sm.purpose: 弹窗标题、手机区块标题、播放队列标题、空状态和出错的标题、logo 字样（17px）。

body.purpose: 手机上的歌名、正文、说明。

label.purpose: 桌面歌名、按钮、导航、chip 文字。

caption.purpose: 歌手、首数、时长、元信息、表头、提示、歌单标签。

micro.purpose: 试听、无版权、未下载徽标。

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: 静止的白色面板、网格封面、搜索框。

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: 菜单、底部弹层、弹窗、播放条、搜索下拉、播放页大封面。

shadows.name: chip
shadows.purpose: 封面上“正在播放”的白色小圆片（shadow-chip），压在什么封面上都分得开；是标记，不算一层纵深。

shadows.name: cover-fog
shadows.value: cover image, inset -20%, filter: blur(64px) saturate(1.15); veil rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8)
shadows.purpose: 播放页由当前封面染出的浅雾，换歌时交叉淡化 700ms；减少动态效果时 150ms 交叉淡化。

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: 所有可聚焦元素的键盘焦点。整行可点的歌曲行例外：焦点环画在行内 2px（outline-offset: -2px），不压到相邻的行；播放页的歌词行同样画在行内。

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: 输入框、搜索框获得焦点或展开时。

motion.name: motion-tokens
motion.value: numbers live only in src/lib/components/motion-tokens.ts; uno.config.ts turns them into CSS variables (--ease-*, --duration-*, --move-*, --delay-*, --loop-*, --loop-state, --press-scale) and utilities (duration-<tier>, duration-move-<tier>, ease-out-soft as the default, ease-in-soft, press, animate-spin); Svelte transitions use float / fade / iconSwap / pop / toast / unfold / fadeThrough / stagger from src/lib/components/motion.ts, written as transition: (one directive, direction-aware, reverses from the current state; delay applies to the intro only) when the element can be toggled back mid-way; atOnce() applies restored page state instantly
motion.purpose: 一处定义时长和曲线；--duration-* 给透明度、颜色、模糊，--move-* 给位移、缩放、宽高、字号。零散的 duration-150、ease-out、motion-reduce: 在 uno.config.ts 的 blocklist 里，lint 报错。

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: 飘入和移动：先快后慢、不回弹。页面和面板飘入、封面飞行、标签指示块、歌词 / 播放队列轨道、换碟、按钮轻缩。

motion.name: ease-in-soft
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1)
motion.purpose: 飘出：越走越快，时长约是飘入的六成。

motion.name: duration-feedback
motion.value: 120ms
motion.purpose: 按下、图标切换（播放和暂停之间交叉淡化，新图标 85% → 100%）、滚动条淡入。

motion.name: duration-state
motion.value: 200ms in / 120ms out
motion.purpose: 行状态（三根竖条长出、歌名变色）、菜单、提示条、通知条展开、滚动条淡出。

motion.name: duration-panel
motion.value: 360ms in / 200ms out
motion.purpose: 换页、歌词 / 播放队列轨道、手机封面 ↔ 歌词、弹窗、播放条第一次浮上来、标签下划线。抽屉保持 380ms。整段换页不超过 0.5 秒。

motion.name: duration-focal
motion.value: 600ms (player page cover wheel); 480ms (wheel in player bars, cover flights)
motion.purpose: 主角动作：换碟、封面飞到页头、封面飞进播放条。

motion.name: float
motion.value: in: opacity 0 → 1 + translate 12px (pages 16px) from the coming side, ease-out-soft; out: opacity 1 → 0 + translate 6px (pages 8px) toward the leaving side, ease-in-soft; the incoming float starts 60ms after the outgoing one
motion.purpose: 全站的飘入飘出。方向：进入下一层从下往上，返回从上往下，同一层按左右顺序，下一首往左。

motion.name: stagger
motion.value: skeleton fades out in place over 120ms (out:fadeAway, gives up its height at once); content floats up 12px over 240ms (in:reveal), 30ms per item, first 6 items only, the rest with the 6th; first reveal only (a page opened with its content already there does not stagger)
motion.purpose: 骨架换成内容时依次飘入；虚拟列表滚动时新挂上的行、换页时的整页不逐个飘。

motion.name: image-in
motion.value: opacity 0 → 1 over 240ms ease-out-soft after load (from the mint-mist ground); none when this session already loaded that URL, so rows a virtual list remounts do not fade again; the fallback icon fades in the same way
motion.purpose: 封面加载完从薄荷底上淡入，缓存里的不再淡一次。

motion.name: play-button
motion.value: play / pause / spinner icons crossfade over 120ms, the incoming icon scales 0.85 → 1 (ease-out-soft); the spinner (animate-spin, 1s linear) only fades in after 300ms of loading or buffering (--delay-spinner)
motion.purpose: 播放键：按下马上换成暂停；地址取过、缓冲一下就好的歌不闪转圈。

motion.name: progress-tick
motion.value: bar progress lines: width / left 250ms linear, one timeupdate interval (--move-tick); hover / focus thickening 120ms
motion.purpose: 常驻播放条的进度线匀速跟上播放器报的进度。减少动态效果时直接跳。

motion.name: page-transition
motion.value: same-document View Transitions; the content area is the root snapshot (the window scrolls, so only a viewport-sized capture is scroll-proof); header, rail, player bars and the player notice carry view-transition-class still (old hidden, new shown live, no animation), the phone top row and tab row carry crossfade (200ms); direction via transition types up / down / left / right / fade; forward: old up 8px out 200ms ease-in-soft, new from 16px below in 360ms ease-out-soft starting 60ms later (420ms in all); back reversed; lateral ±24px in; desktop playlist rail switch: matched 200ms crossfade with mix-blend-mode plus-lighter (overriding animation drops the UA's plus-lighter, identical regions would dim); phone tab line (view-transition-name tab-line) slides 360ms; shared cover (view-transition-name cover, only on the tapped tile — grid or desktop playlist rail — and the header, all fetching the same 400px thumbnail; on the desktop playlist page the header is preferred, the current rail tile takes off or lands only when the header is scrolled away) 480ms ease-out-soft, radius crossfades 12px → 16px; flies back to every grid page a page was entered from (a page revisited via the rail keeps each origin); no flight when the header is still a skeleton, the tile is off screen or either image is not loaded (landing waits at most 100ms), the lone departing cover drifts out with the page
motion.purpose: 换页（ADR-0011）。顶栏、侧栏、播放条不动，进度线照常走；从格子进歌单、专辑、歌手时封面飞到页头，返回飞回仍在屏幕里的格子；返回时滚动位置在拍新的一帧前恢复；hasUAVisualTransition 时跳过；过渡中再换页 skipTransition()；过渡中按下就结束过渡，点按交给新页面上手指下的元素。减少动态效果：只剩 150ms 交叉淡化。

motion.name: cover-wheel
motion.value: pivot below the cover center at 1.6 × cover size; 28° between covers; next = counter-clockwise; 600ms (player page) / 480ms (player bars) ease-out-soft, Web Animations from each cover's current pose so it can be interrupted; title, artist, album follow 80ms later (out 12px left over 120ms, in from 16px right over 200ms starting 60ms after; bars use the default float distances; a title still waiting to float in is dropped when the song changes again); tint crossfade 700ms; played wave drains to start in 200ms; desktop player page masks the wheel to the left column, fading over half the column gap on each side; a list pick turns left like next when its cover cannot fly (row cover not loaded yet), a flown-in cover lands as a plain swap; reduced motion crossfades in place (150ms, opacity only); page hidden: swap at once
motion.purpose: 签名动作“换碟”。方向看 App 发布的换歌原因；只在自己那一栏里转；可打断，从此刻的角度直接转向最新那首。手机播放页左右滑封面：拖过一格的 1/4 或每秒 1000px 一甩就切歌，否则 240ms 转回原位；横着挪过 6px 才算拖。

motion.name: cover-flight
motion.value: song row cover → player bar cover slot: a fixed img on top (z 45, under the notice and player page), 480ms ease-out-soft along a shallow quadratic arc bulging upward (control point 0.12 × chord length off the midpoint), scaling from the row size to the slot size; on landing the bar swaps the cover at once while the old title floats up out (120ms) and the new one floats up in (200ms, 60ms later); if the slot's thumbnail is not loaded yet the plane stays on the slot until it has loaded and faded in (240ms), so the empty mint ground never shows; a newer pick, next / previous or an emptied queue removes the plane at once; first appearance of the bar: floats up from just below the screen edge in 360ms (opacity follows), sinks back in 200ms when the queue empties (clear, sign out); layout switches and login expiry drop it without sinking
motion.purpose: 点歌时封面飞进播放条。点的是正在放的那首、在播放页的播放队列里点歌时不飞；连续快点只有最后一首在飞。

motion.name: panel-track
motion.value: lyrics / queue panels side by side, track translateX 0 ↔ -50% over 360ms ease-out-soft, in step with the tab indicator
motion.purpose: 桌面播放页右栏换标签。两块都一直挂着，看不见的那块不能被 Tab 到。

motion.name: sheet-in
motion.value: translateY(100%) ↔ 0 of its own height, 380ms quart-out; backdrop opacity follows the position
motion.purpose: 手机底部弹层（播放队列）按自己的高度滑进滑出，和播放页同一套抽屉：拉手往下拖收起，底下的“播放队列”往上拖拉开。

motion.name: popover-in
motion.value: 200ms ease-out-soft from 4px off the anchor side and scale 0.98; out: 120ms fade (motion.ts pop, transition:pop, reverses mid-way)
motion.purpose: 桌面浮动菜单（账号菜单、歌曲的“更多”菜单）、搜索下拉。连点时从此刻的样子掉头，不留残影。

motion.name: toast
motion.value: notice bars float in 12px from their edge over 200ms ease-out-soft, fade out over 120ms ease-in-soft; when the bar changes place (phone player page opens / closes) the old one fades out and the new one only fades in (motion.ts toast, moved)
motion.purpose: 播放提示、以后的“已加入歌单”；“登录已经失效”跟着登录页从上面飘进来。

motion.name: unfold
motion.value: a strip that pushes content below: height 0 → auto over 200ms (ease-out-soft in, ease-in-soft out) on a wrapper without margin / padding; content fades in during the second half and drifts 12px down, fades out first on the way out; opacity and drift follow the height so it reverses smoothly; reduced motion: height jumps, 150ms fade
motion.purpose: 首次同步的通知条、歌单内搜索的“找到几首”“没加载完”、表单的报错和提示：“不动布局”的例外。

motion.name: fade-through
motion.value: old content fades out over 120ms, then the new content fades in over 240ms; both stacked in one grid cell (motion.ts fadeThrough)
motion.purpose: 歌单的 全部 / 自建 / 收藏 筛选：整个格子换，不让格子各自挪位。

motion.name: crossfade-in-place
motion.value: old and new stacked in one grid cell (grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)], col-start-1 row-start-1), in 200ms / out 120ms; app screens (opening, login, library, errors): new screen fades in over 360ms, the old one fades out in place over 200ms and gives up its height at once (out:fadeAway)
motion.purpose: 歌单内搜索的列表、二维码各步骤、歌词的加载中 ↔ 歌词、图标按钮换图标、整个 App 换屏。登录方式换的时候横着走（360 / 200ms），卡片高度跟着变（360ms）。

motion.name: stagger-more
motion.value: items appended to a shown group float up 12px over 240ms, 30ms apart for the first 6 (motion.ts stagger)
motion.purpose: 歌手页“显示更多专辑”、首次同步时桌面歌单页左栏的歌单。

motion.name: description-expand
motion.value: album description height animates from its current height to the new one (open 360ms, close 200ms, ease-out-soft) and reverses mid-way; clamps to 3 / 4 lines only after closing
motion.purpose: 专辑简介展开、收起：下面的歌曲跟着平稳地挪。

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.value: backdrop fade 200ms; dialog from 8px below and scale 0.98 in 360ms ease-out-soft; out: 200ms fade
motion.purpose: 编辑、删除确认这类弹窗。

motion.name: morning-row
motion.value: --wash-progress 260ms linear (registered <number> custom property); on song change the old light fades out over 300ms, the new light fades in from the left edge over 200ms
motion.purpose: 晨光行随播放进度推进，只重绘不重排；换歌时不一帧消失。

motion.name: now-bars
motion.value: --loop-now-bars 1.1s ease-in-out infinite alternate, the three bars at 1× / 0.8× / 1.2× with staggered starts; grow from scaleY(0) in 200ms when a row becomes current, shrink back in 120ms
motion.purpose: 正在播放的三根竖条；暂停时停住。

motion.name: wave-flow
motion.value: path translateX 24px over 1.8s linear infinite (paused unless playing); wave height 7px → 0 in 160ms on pause, 0 → 7px in 420ms on play, cubic-out (the path is redrawn, stroke stays 3px)
motion.purpose: 波浪进度线只在播放时起伏、流动；暂停（和拖动游标）时马上抹平成一条直线，再播放时渐渐起伏回来。减少动态效果时：线不流动，起伏直接切换不渐变，游标只跟着播放器报的进度跳（约 250ms 一次）。

motion.name: lyric-word
motion.value: clip-path: inset(-0.25em <未唱的百分比> -0.25em 0)，每帧按播放时刻重算（播放器约 250ms 报一次进度，中间按经过的时间往前推）
motion.purpose: 逐字歌词点亮：上层按唱到的比例裁切点亮，唱到一半的字只亮一半。减少动态效果时逐字点亮跟着播放器报的进度跳。

motion.name: lyric-line
motion.value: font-size / line-height / color 300ms; scrollTo current line at 38% of the lyric area, behavior: smooth
motion.purpose: 换到下一行歌词：当前行变大变深，滚到约 38% 的高度停住；听众自己滚动歌词后，3 秒内不跟着当前行走。减少动态效果时直接跳过去不平滑滚动，字号直接变，颜色在 150ms 内渐变。

motion.name: player-page-drawer
motion.value: drawer: translateY(100%) ↔ 0 over 380ms quart-out (after a drag release: 380ms × remaining distance, at least 120ms); top radius grows 0 → 24px as it leaves the top; library behind dims up to 20%
motion.purpose: 播放页是一层抽屉，打开时从底下升起、收起时缩回底下。拖动把手（桌面顶上正中、手机的“正在播放”）或播放条时跟着手走，挪过 10px（鼠标 2px）才开始拖，先往横里挪的不算；松手时从按下的地方拖过自身露出来的高度的 1/4 或整段平均速度超过 0.4px/ms 就拉开 / 收起，不到就回到浅路由说的那一头；往拉开那边拉过头时按 8·(ln(v+1)−2) 阻尼、最多 48px，抽屉底下多垫 48px 底色。按住断了（右键、切走窗口、松开没传到页面）就作废、弹回。减少动态效果时直接到位。

motion.name: bone-sweep
motion.value: background-position 100% → -140% over 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; gradient #E3EAE6 → #F0F5F2 → #E3EAE6 at 240% width
motion.purpose: 加载中的骨架（歌曲行、封面格子、歌词、登录二维码）：一道很淡的光从左扫到右；减少动态效果时停住（animation-play-state: var(--loop-state)）。循环来回用 CSS 自带的 ease-in-out，不算第三条曲线。

motion.name: scrollbar
motion.value: native scrollbars hidden (scrollbar-width: none); overlay thumb 4px graphite-soft at 45% at rest → 8px mint-stem on hover (16px edge zone) or drag; fades in 120ms on scroll, out 200ms after 1s idle
motion.purpose: 自绘滚动条（ADR-0012），不占宽度，锁住滚动时页面不横移。拖滑块、点空白处翻一屏；不进 Tab 顺序；除了听众操作从不写滚动位置。触屏只在滚动时显示。

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → no translation, rotation, scale, flights or loops; opacity and color changes stay, at most 150ms. Implemented once: the CSS tokens switch (--duration-* capped at 150ms, --move-* 0ms, --loop-state paused, --press-scale 1) and the JS helpers in motion.ts (float / fade / iconSwap drop translation and scale, fadeMs caps at 150ms, moveMs is 0, scrollBehavior is auto); components never test the media query
motion.purpose: 减少动态效果是“更少、更轻”，不是全部关掉：波浪不流动、三根竖条和骨架不动、逐字点亮和游标跟着报的进度跳、歌词滚动不平滑、换页和换碟只交叉淡化、不飞封面、封面染底 150ms 交叉淡化、抽屉和弹层打开收起直接到位；拖动时照样跟着手走。

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: 手机布局：顶部文字标签、迷你播放条、底部弹层。

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: 桌面布局：顶栏 + 72px 图标侧栏 + 80px 底栏。

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: 桌面歌单页显示左侧 208px 的歌单栏（窄于 1024px 收起，从曲库进出歌单）；播放页左列固定 320–420px（窄于 1024px 两栏按比例分）。

breakpoints.name: input
breakpoints.purpose: 悬停效果只在鼠标下出现；右键菜单按输入方式而不是宽度。

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 实心深绿胶囊：播放全部、登录、重试。
components.html: <button class='ds-btn ds-btn-primary'><svg width='16' height='16' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='currentColor' aria-hidden='true'><polygon points='6 3 20 12 6 21 6 3'/></svg>播放全部</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Variable', 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'Noto Sans JP Variable', 'Noto Sans TC Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2B976F; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #206F52; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1A5B43; }

components.name: Download Button
components.description: 浅蜜桃胶囊：下载（这台设备）。
components.html: <button class='ds-btn ds-btn-download'><svg width='16' height='16' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' aria-hidden='true'><circle cx='12' cy='12' r='10'/><path d='M12 8v8'/><path d='m8 12 4 4 4-4'/></svg>下载</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Variable', 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'Noto Sans JP Variable', 'Noto Sans TC Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-download { background: #FFEEE2; color: #B34719; } .ds-btn-download:hover { background: #FFE1CC; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: 描边白胶囊：桌面的次级操作（收藏 / 已收藏、添加歌曲、排序、新建歌单、清空、取消）。手机上排在一行里的次级操作只留图标或写成文字（DESIGN.md Buttons · 手机上的四档）。
components.html: <button class='ds-btn ds-btn-outline'><svg width='16' height='16' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='#206F52' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round' aria-hidden='true'><path d='M20 6 9 17l-5-5'/></svg>已收藏</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 20px 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Noto Sans Variable', 'Noto Sans SC Variable', 'Noto Sans JP Variable', 'Noto Sans TC Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1F2937; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #B9EAD5; background: #F3FBF7; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: 顶栏搜索框：胶囊形，展开或聚焦时薄荷边 + 薄荷雾光环。

narrative.overview:
Campanula 是风铃草。界面像清晨窗边的一株风铃草：整页是一层带薄荷味的晨光底，白色面板是轻轻浮在上面的纸，薄荷绿只出现在“被选中”“正在走”的地方：正在播放的那一行、进度、焦点、当前的导航项。画面里真正浓烈的颜色来自歌曲封面，它们大多是色彩饱满的动漫插画；界面退在封面后面，给它让位。

手机和桌面共用这一套系统，区别只在布局和交互方式。手机照 Auxio 的交互：顶部文字标签、Auxio 式歌曲行、浮起的迷你播放条、底部弹层。桌面以原来的 Campanula 为蓝本：64px 顶栏（搜索框在正中）、72px 图标侧栏、内容区、80px 底部通栏。桌面打开是整个曲库的分区总览：我喜欢的音乐（三行横向歌曲格）、每日推荐方块、歌单、专辑、歌手。播放页是一层由当前封面染出的淡雾，进度是一条柔和的波浪线，歌词逐字点亮。

这套系统拒绝四样东西：Tailwind 默认观感；用 emoji 或 Unicode 字符当图标；只在悬停时出现的操作；粉彩色底上放白字。
keyCharacteristics: 浅色唯一（ADR-0008），整页底色是晨光底，不是灰。
白色面板带极淡的环境光阴影；只有真正浮起的层（菜单、弹层、播放条）才有更明显的阴影。
颜色有固定分工：薄荷 = 选中与进度，珊瑚 = 红心，蜜桃 = 本机与下载；封面是画面里最饱和的东西。
按钮分层：每屏只有主操作是实心深绿胶囊（下载是浅蜜桃）；手机上和标题、数量排在一行的次级操作只留图标，图标说不清、点错有代价的写成文字；桌面的次级操作是描边白胶囊。
Noto 可变字体（自托管），只用 400 / 500 / 600 三个真实字重；日文、繁体按 lang 切换字体。
签名动作“晨光行”：正在播放的那一行，被一层浅薄荷光从歌名开始往右慢慢铺开。
动效是“飘入飘出”：东西从来的方向轻轻飘来、停稳，离开时先淡再走，不弹跳；封面是主角，动效跟着封面走。
第二个签名动作“换碟”：切歌时，封面像挂在一个看不见的转盘上，下一张沿弧线转到正中。

rules.name: The Morning Light Rule
rules.body: 晨光底是晨光，白色是纸，薄荷绿只出现在“选中”“进度”“正在播放”上。画面里最饱和的颜色属于封面，不属于界面。

rules.name: The Dark Ink on Pastel Rule
rules.body: 粉彩色上只放深色字：薄荷浅底配森林墨（6.6:1 以上），蜜桃浅底配蜜桃木（4.8:1 以上）。白字只出现在深薄荷、森林墨、出错红这几种深色实心底上（6:1 以上）。

rules.name: The One Job per Color Rule
rules.body: 每种颜色只管一件事：珊瑚只是红心，蜜桃只是本机和下载，试听用琥珀色而不是蜜桃。不要拿它们来装饰。

rules.name: The Three Real Weights Rule
rules.body: 只用 400 / 500 / 600 三个字重，而且都是字体文件里真实存在的字重（font-synthesis: none）。不再出现浏览器模拟出来的粗体。

rules.name: The Mixed Script Rule
rules.body: 显示歌名、歌手、专辑、歌单名的元素必须带 lang：含假名的标 ja，繁体标 zh-TW，其余跟随页面的 zh-CN。字体检查页逐字测过：按 lang 切换后，假名字宽一致，没有回退造成的空隙。

rules.name: The Ambient Light Rule
rules.body: 静止的面板只用环境光；浮起阴影只给“浮在内容上、可以关掉”的层。阴影表达的是“纸离开桌面”，不是层级的高低。

rules.name: The Light-Only Fog Rule
rules.body: 封面染底永远是浅色的：白纱不低于 80%，深色封面上的次要文字也要保持 4.5:1。不做深色播放页。

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: 来有来处，去有去向：每个飘入都从它来的方向来，每个飘出都朝它去的方向走；不弹、不晃、不为好看而转。去掉以后听众会看不懂刚才发生了什么的动效，才值得做。

rules.name: The Cover Leads Rule
rules.body: 封面是主角，同一时刻只有一张封面在飞；飞行只落在已经加载好的图片上，终点看不见或图片没到，就退回普通的飘入。

dos: Do 让封面承担画面里最饱和的颜色；薄荷只用在选中、进度、正在播放、焦点上（The Morning Light Rule）。
Do 在粉彩浅底上放深色字：薄荷浅底配森林墨，蜜桃浅底配蜜桃木（The Dark Ink on Pastel Rule）。
Do 主要动作用实心深绿胶囊，下载用浅蜜桃胶囊；桌面的次要动作用描边白胶囊，手机上照 Buttons 的四档：排在一行里的次级操作只留图标或写成文字，选项用 chip 或分段条。
Do 统一用 Lucide 线条图标；文案里提到“更多”菜单时，画出同一个图标，或者直接写“更多”。
Do 显示歌名、歌手、专辑、歌单名时带上 lang。
Do 加载中用形状一致的骨架行，放在列表本来的位置上；空、出错、离线都要写清楚发生了什么、能怎么办。
Do 头部的首数、已下载数和下面实际显示的列表对得上。
Do 每个动效都说得出它在解释什么：操作生效了、东西从哪来到哪去、现在是什么状态（The Float Rule）。
Do 新的动效同时写好“减少动态效果”时的样子：去掉位移，留下 150ms 以内的淡入淡出。
donts: Don't 在薄荷、蜜桃、珊瑚的粉彩底上放白字。
Don't 使用近黑的中性色（#111827）当按钮的实心底色；实心按钮只有深薄荷、森林墨和删除用的出错红。
Don't 用 emoji 或 Unicode 字符（包括 •••、▶、♥）当图标。
Don't 只在鼠标悬停时才显示操作按钮；不要求双击才播放。
Don't 在底部播放条里一行塞满控件；音质、歌词开关这类放进播放页。
Don't 给不需要专注的任务开居中弹窗：桌面搜索挂在顶栏下面，结果是内容区里的一页；弹窗只给编辑、删除确认这类要打断一下的操作。
Don't 在页面一打开时弹出无关提示，也不要让浮动按钮压住列表。
Don't 让 logo 一直旋转，也不要改它的图形和颜色。
Don't 做深色模式，或为深色模式预留变量（ADR-0008）。
Don't 用回弹、弹簧、来回晃的曲线，也不要为好看让东西转圈、闪烁（换碟的转盘有含义，不算）。
Don't 让听众等动画：内容到了就显示，不为了编排先藏起来；整段换页不超过 0.5 秒。
Don't 接管滚轮和触控板的滚动手感，也不要用 JS 模拟滚动（ADR-0012）。
Don't 给虚拟列表的每一行加入场动画。
